description: Boundary coverage for the two base predicates. For self-identification, adds the rejection paths the native suite omits: a candidate that reports is_self_agent=false and one that omits the flag entirely are both rejected, while a self-reporting candidate is admitted, all in one input-ordered batch. For admit-all, a heterogeneous batch confirms every candidate is admitted regardless of its attributes. Output lists each candidate as its name and whether it was admitted.

cases.expected_output:
container=self included=true
container=other included=false
container=unset included=false

container=plain included=true
container=with_enable included=true
container=agent included=true
